name: Anna VetoLayer
tagline: A policy and human-approval checkpoint for consequential AI actions.
description:
Anna VetoLayer evaluates a proposed AI-agent action before it executes. A bundled deterministic policy engine handles hard safety rules first. Anna AI is called only when context genuinely matters, unresolved actions enter a human review queue, and every verdict becomes a durable Decision Receipt.

Use it for production changes, permission updates, financial operations, external communications, data exports, and other high-impact tool calls.
